ModMetaData.name: Pain Affects Movement
ModMetaData.author: yourname
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a dedicated pain-to-move-speed penalty instead of relying on pain's indirect effect through Consciousness.
Below 20% pain, movement is unaffected. From 20% to 80% pain, move speed drops linearly, reaching a maximum penalty of -40% at 80% pain (and staying there beyond 80%).
Note: this stacks on top of vanilla's existing pain -> Consciousness -> Moving chain, which still applies since it's calculated deep in health code. If you'd rather fully replace that chain, that needs a separate Harmony patch on the capacity calculation - ask if you want that added.
